title: CohortBridge channel outreach — quick jot
content:
Purpose: scratchpad for outreach to CohortBridge (channel partnership idea: integrated LLM-powered tutoring/chat into their instructor dashboard + syllabus augmentation). Quick capture of research, angles, email drafts, call script, objections + counters, next steps.

Background notes (quick):
- Company: CohortBridge — cohort-based learning platform focused on short instructor-led courses for professionals. Mid-market to upper-mid market customers (education nonprofits and bootcamps).
- Primary pain: instructor bandwidth, student drop-off, scaling TA support; want to surface personalized hints and grading rubrics at scale.
- Likely constraints: tight budgets, conservative procurement cycles (procurement + security reviews for enterprise accounts), EU customers => data residency concerns.
- Technical maturity: product-led growth with engineering team of ~15, uses AWS, some customers insist on VPC/private deployments.

Initial research hits / signals:
- Job postings: ML infra engineer + platform eng in last 6 months — they care about latency and cost.
- Recent blog: "Scaling cohorts without hiring more TAs" — suggests interest in automation plays.
- Public case studies mention customers in EU — flag for Private/VPC or hosted with EU region SLA.

Value props to emphasize (redwood-relevant):
- Predictable latency and autoscaling for bursts on demo days (fast replies at <200ms p95 for chat flows with our Dedicated pools).
- Cost controls: batching, KV caching, quantization recommendations can reduce per-token unit economics vs naive hosting.
- Private/VPC option + audit logs for regulated partners (sells to universities or corporate training).
- Easy pilot: limited reserved capacity for pilot week (can pin model + fallback to cheaper variant).

Who to target / personas:
- Head of Partnerships / Business Development: value, go-to-market integration and revenue share thoughts.
- Head of Product / PM: use-cases, feasibility, pilot scope.
- Lead Platform Engineer / CTO: security, VPC, SLA, integration points.
- Head of Customer Success: retention/use case metrics (reduced drop-off, time to resolution).

Cold subject line ideas (A/B test these):
1) Quick pilot idea: AI TAs for CohortBridge instructors
2) Reduce TA load on demo days — 1-week pilot?
3) CohortBridge x Redwood — private, low-latency tutoring assistant

Two short email openers (templates):
- Version A (concise):
Hey <Name>,
I like CohortBridge's approach to cohort learning — quick idea: we can run a 1-week pilot that surfaces AI TAs inside the instructor dashboard with predictable latency and no data leaves your VPC. Interested in a 15–20 minute intro?
— Samira (Redwood Inference)

- Version B (value-first):
Hi <Name>,
We helped a similar cohort-based platform cut TA triage time by ~40% using a private inference integration (dedicated GPU pools + caching). Could we run a short pilot to show the same for a single course? Low lift from your side.

Call script (30–40 minute discovery):
- 0–5m: reason for call, quick intro to Redwood (hosted/dedicated/private options)
- 5–12m: understand current TA/instructor workflow, volume (messages/day, peak concurrency on demo days), existing infra constraints
- 12–20m: technical checkpoints — data residency, PII policy, authentication, where to run inference (VPC vs hosted), model outputs (grading vs helper hints)
- 20–30m: pilot proposal (scope: 1 course, 2 weeks pilot, reserved capacity X GPUs or hosted EU region, success metrics)
- 30–35m: commercial ask / next steps — intro to platform lead + CS for onboarding

Objections + suggested counters (working list):
- "We can’t send student data to a third party." -> Counter: we offer Private deployment (customer-controlled control plane + optional on-prem package). We can also enable field-level redaction and audit logs.
- "AI outputs are unpredictable / risky for grading." -> Counter: propose narrow scope (suggestions only, not graded output) + human-in-the-loop. Provide eval prompts and rollback policy; Redwood Optimize can track regressions on prompt sets.
- "Cost concerns / tight L&D budgets." -> Counter: pricing anchor for pilot (flat pilot fee + usage cap) and show unit-economics: caching + quantization can drop inference cost per session by 30–50%.
- "Latency spikes during live sessions." -> Counter: Dedicated pools + autoscaling + smart routing; fallback to lighter model variant. We can simulate demo-day concurrency during pilot.

Pilot success criteria (proposed):
- TA time saved: 30% reduction in triage messages for the pilot course over 2 weeks
- Response latency: p95 < 250ms for chat helper flows during peak
- Engagement: 20% of students use assistant at least once per session
- Ops: zero PII incidents, all requests logged to their KMS-enabled audit trail

Technical integration notes (quick):
- Preferred integrations: REST API + small JS widget embeddable in instructor dashboard.
- Auth: API keys with per-route tokens; optionally mTLS into their VPC connector.
- Data flow: events -> Redwood inference -> UI; optionally mirror logs to their S3 (audit).
- Fallback policy: route to smaller LLM if Reserved Dedicated pool at capacity.

Commercial / pricing sketch (anchor for convo):
- Pilot: 2-week pilot, flat $4,500 + usage cap (or free credit if CS supports)
- Post-pilot: reserved capacity pricing or usage-based hosted contract. Example: $X per 1M tokens + $Y/month reserved baseline for Dedicated. (need to pull exact numbers from pricing playbook before proposal)

Notes to self / unresolved Qs:
- Who at CohortBridge is driving partnerships? PR follow-up from Miguel: LinkedIn outreach found "Lydia Brooks — Head of Partnerships" but need confirmation.
- Confirm whether they have EU-resident customers requiring on-prem/VPC — thread in slack: #g2m-cohortbridge has a comment (see linked artifacts).
- Spin up small demo flow: create sample instructor prompt set + rubric (ask Priya to draft). Ticket: GROW-1123 assigned for kit.

Next actions (today / this week):
- Send short intro email to Lydia (A/B subject lines) — target Tue morning.
- Miguel to add product screenshots to Confluence page for discovery by EPD.
- Schedule 45m on-call with Platform Eng (Miguel + Priya + 30m overlap) to confirm likely pilot footprint and cost estimate.
- Prepare quick demo: embed JS widget + sample course prompts (Priya)

Rough timeline: outreach -> discovery (1–2 weeks) -> pilot run (2 weeks) -> analyze & propose commercial (1 week).

Random scratch thoughts:
- Could position revenue-share on upsell features (graded answer generation) later — but avoid revenue talk early.
- Consider offering joint webinar for instructors after a successful pilot (marketing angle)

-- end scratchpad --

(Notes peppered with shorthand — clean into Confluence page once discovery call confirmed.)
